coordinate_convention: Planetocentric east-positive longitude stored in -180..180 deg on the SELENORA MOON_ME sphere (R=1737.4 km)
me_pa_policy: NSSDC and LROC Wagner et al. 2016 publish a single Mean Earth/Polar Axis (ME/PA) DE421 body-fixed product. Catalog preserves source_coordinate_system wording per mission and does NOT invent a separate ME-only vs PA-only remapping. IAU Gazetteer centroids (Planetographic +East -180..180) are used only for planned/failed target REGION rings, never as actual landings.
disclaimer: Historical and planned mission catalog compiled from NASA NSSDC, LROC (Wagner et al. 2016) and NASA CLPS mission pages. Planned targets are feature-region references only and are NEVER actual landing coordinates. This catalog is informational; it is NOT a NASA landing-site recommendation and is not used by SELENORA scoring. Apollo historical sites are plotted only on the global 3D Moon — never as south-polar Explorer basemap pins.

missions.name: Apollo 11
missions.coordinate_precision_note: LM Eagle lander position, LRO NAC imagery (Wagner et al. 2016).
missions.notes: First crewed lunar landing (Mare Tranquillitatis). NSSDC table gives LRRR 0.67345N/23.47307E and LM 0.67416N/23.47314E; LM position stored. Coordinates are planetocentric ME/PA (DE421) per NSSDC; uncertainty from Wagner et al. 2016 (Icarus 283, 92-103).
missions.source_frame_label: Mean Earth/Polar Axis (ME/PA), DE421 — as cited by NSSDC/LROC

missions.coordinate_precision_note: Propulsion anomaly after launch; lander never reached lunar orbit and re-entered over the Pacific on 2024-01-18. No landing occurred.

planned_target.note: IAU Gazetteer feature centroid of the planned target bay (Feature 16118, ~68 km across). Shown as an APPROXIMATE REGION ring only; never an actual landing point.
planned_target.coordinate_system_note: IAU Gazetteer center (Planetographic +East -180..180). Feature centroid REGION only — not a landing ellipse.

missions.notes: NASA CLPS TO2-AB. NASA CLPS page: 'launched Jan 8, 2024 ... did not land'. Planned target centroid is the IAU Gazetteer Sinus Viscositatis feature centre, NOT a landing ellipse.
missions.source_frame_label: No verified landing coordinates (no touchdown or not yet flown)

missions.name: IM-1 Odysseus (TO2-IM)
missions.coordinate_precision_note: Coordinates reported to 0.01 deg (~300 m at this latitude) by LROC; no formal uncertainty published. LROC places the lander in a degraded ~1 km crater on a ~12 deg slope near Malapert A; the vehicle tipped onto its side but returned science data.
missions.notes: First commercial soft landing on the Moon (2024-02-22 23:23 UTC). South-polar (lat <= -80). Tipped over during touchdown; operated from sideways attitude. Marker precision limited to ~0.01 deg.
missions.source_frame_label: Mean Earth/Polar Axis (ME/PA), DE421 — as cited by NSSDC/LROC

missions.name: Blue Ghost Mission 1
missions.coordinate_precision_note: Coordinates to 4 decimal places from LRO NAC image M1495619099LR (LROC, 2025-03-07); formal uncertainty not published. Elevation ~ -3650 m, Mare Crisium near Mons Latreille.
missions.notes: NASA CLPS TO19D. Successful landing 2025-03-02 in Mare Crisium; payloads operated through lunar sunset (completed).
missions.source_frame_label: Mean Earth/Polar Axis (ME/PA), DE421 — as cited by NSSDC/LROC

missions.name: IM-2 Athena (PRIME-1)
missions.coordinate_precision_note: Coordinates to 4 decimal places from LRO NAC image M1495922531LR (LROC, 2025-03-10); formal uncertainty not published. LROC: touchdown near the center of Mons Mouton; lander came to rest on its side inside a ~20 m crater and operated briefly (>400 MB returned).
missions.notes: NASA CLPS PRIME-1 delivery to the lunar south pole. Landed 2025-03-06; tipped over on its side, mission ended early. Southernmost landing to date.
missions.source_frame_label: Mean Earth/Polar Axis (ME/PA), DE421 — as cited by NSSDC/LROC
